item.title: Bumthang
item.description: Mebar Tsho, the sacred lake where a lamp burned bright underwater. Bumthang is a picturesque region in central Bhutan, widely regarded as the cultural heartland of the country. It is known for its sacred monasteries, historical sites, and scenic valleys. The region consists of four main valleys: Chokhor, Tang, Ura, and Chhume, each with its own cultural and historical importance. Cultural significance Bumthang is home to some of Bhutan’s most important religious and historical sites.
